The signing behavior change — that the Windows embeddable zip now gets signed for stable releases — is exercised by the release pipeline itself through the SignPath approval step and the AuthenticodeSignature verification in the workflow. subject: ci: sign the Windows embeddable archive in the same SignPath request as the MSIs (#4219)
summary: Bundles the Windows server MSI and embeddable ZIP into one artifact so they are signed together in a single SignPath request, and publishes the signed embeddable zip for stable releases while keeping the unsigned version for release candidates.
verdict_reason: CI-only change reviewed by a maintainer with CI subject-area expertise; no user-facing surface to test.
